title: AxiomDiagnosticRequest
description: Request body for POST /api/diagnose. One entry per axiom, all four required.

stance.description: The stated default. A and B are the two opposing primaries; C re-architects the question at system level.

conviction.description: How much weight the participant believes this default carries.

breaking_point.description: The condition that would make the participant abandon the stance. The strongest signal in the payload.
